# ExAthena v0.17.0 - Table of Contents

Provider-agnostic agent loop for Elixir. Drop-in replacement for the Claude
Code SDK that runs on Ollama, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, llama.cpp, or
Anthropic itself — same tools, hooks, permissions, and streaming across all
providers. Includes a full Igniter installer.

## Modules

- [ExAthena.Chat.Commands](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Commands.md): Pure parser + dispatcher for slash commands in the `mix athena.chat` REPL.
- [ExAthena.Chat.Exo](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Exo.md): Talks to a local exo cluster's HTTP API (https://github.com/exo-explore/exo)
for chat-time helpers.
- [ExAthena.Chat.LlamaCpp](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.LlamaCpp.md): Talks to a local llama.cpp server's OpenAI-compatible HTTP API for chat-time helpers.
- [ExAthena.Chat.Ollama](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Ollama.md): Talks to a local Ollama daemon's native HTTP API for chat-time helpers.
- [ExAthena.Chat.Session](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Session.md): In-memory state for one interactive `mix athena.chat` session.
- [ExAthena.Chat.Tui](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Tui.md): Full-screen TUI App for `mix athena.chat`, built on `ExRatatui.App`.
- [ExAthena.Chat.Tui.Runner](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Tui.Runner.md): Bridges `ExAthena.run/2` with the `ExAthena.Chat.Tui` App process.
- [ExAthena.Chat.Tui.State](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Tui.State.md): Pure state container for the `mix athena.chat` TUI.
- [ExAthena.Chat.Tui.View](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Chat.Tui.View.md): Pure view function for `ExAthena.Chat.Tui`. Turns a `%State{}` into the
list of `{widget, %Rect{}}` tuples the ex_ratatui runtime needs.
- [ExAthena.Compactors.ObservationMask](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactors.ObservationMask.md): Observation masking — the research-validated middle layer between
source-side tool caps and whole-transcript summarization.
- [ExAthena.Conclusions](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Conclusions.md): Per-iteration conclusion extraction.
- [ExAthena.GitDiff](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.GitDiff.md): Single source of truth for the "all working-tree changes vs HEAD" diff that
the chat UIs render (web Git tab + TUI Changes tab).
- [ExAthena.LogFile](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.LogFile.md): Optional file logging for the `athena.web` / `athena.chat` mix tasks.
- [ExAthena.Loop.FenceFilter](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Loop.FenceFilter.md): Pure streaming filter that removes `~~~tool_call ... ~~~` and
`~~~tool_result ... ~~~` fenced blocks from chunked assistant text.
- [ExAthena.Lsp](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Lsp.md): Public facade for the LSP subsystem.
- [ExAthena.Lsp.Client](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Lsp.Client.md): GenServer wrapping a stdio `Port` that speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 (LSP framing).
- [ExAthena.Lsp.Framing](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Lsp.Framing.md): Pure decoder for LSP's `Content-Length`-prefixed JSON-RPC framing.
- [ExAthena.Lsp.ImplicitDiagnostics](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Lsp.ImplicitDiagnostics.md): PostToolUse hook that automatically fetches LSP diagnostics after Edit/Write
tool calls and injects any errors or warnings into the next turn's tool-result.
- [ExAthena.Lsp.Manager](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Lsp.Manager.md): Manages one `ExAthena.Lsp.Client` per `{project_root, language}` pair.
- [ExAthena.Lsp.ServerRegistry](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Lsp.ServerRegistry.md): Maps file extensions to language atoms and language atoms to LSP server
spawn specifications.
- [ExAthena.Lsp.Supervisor](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Lsp.Supervisor.md): Top-level supervisor for the LSP subsystem.
- [ExAthena.Mcp.Config](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Mcp.Config.md): Loads and validates MCP server configuration.
- [ExAthena.Mcp.Config.Server](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Mcp.Config.Server.md): Validated MCP server configuration entry.
- [ExAthena.Mcp.Server](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Mcp.Server.md): Per-MCP-server GenServer. Owns one `Client` and the cached tool catalog.
- [ExAthena.Mcp.Supervisor](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Mcp.Supervisor.md): Supervises one `ExAthena.Mcp.Server` per enabled MCP server config entry,
plus the `ExAthena.Mcp.Registry`.
- [ExAthena.Mcp.Tool](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Mcp.Tool.md): Executor for MCP-backed tool specs.
- [ExAthena.Messages.ContentPart](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Messages.ContentPart.md): A single piece of content within a message — text, inline image, image URL, or file.
- [ExAthena.Modes.Orchestrate](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Modes.Orchestrate.md): Orchestrator mode: plan → todo → delegate each step to a subagent →
integrate summaries → finish.
- [ExAthena.Orchestrator.AgentInfo](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Orchestrator.AgentInfo.md): Observable state of one agent (the main loop or a subagent) in an
orchestrated run — the pure functional core of
`ExAthena.Orchestrator.Coordinator`.
- [ExAthena.Orchestrator.Coordinator](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Orchestrator.Coordinator.md): Per-run orchestration blackboard.
- [ExAthena.Providers.ClaudeCode](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Providers.ClaudeCode.md): Provider that wraps the `claude_code` SDK — the local `claude` CLI driven by
an Anthropic **subscription / OAuth token** (`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`) or a
logged-in CLI. **No `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is required.**
- [ExAthena.Providers.ClaudeCode.ModelSource](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Providers.ClaudeCode.ModelSource.md): Boundary for discovering the models the local Claude Code CLI supports.
- [ExAthena.Providers.ClaudeCode.SDKModelSource](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Providers.ClaudeCode.SDKModelSource.md): Real `ExAthena.Providers.ClaudeCode.ModelSource` backed by the `claude_code` SDK.
- [ExAthena.Search](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Search.md): Behaviour for web-search backends.
- [ExAthena.Search.Http](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Search.Http.md): HTTP-backed `ExAthena.Search` implementation. Backend-agnostic: the actual
provider is chosen by config and is the *only* provider-specific code here.
- [ExAthena.Search.Result](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Search.Result.md): One normalized web-search hit. Backends map their provider-specific JSON/HTML
into this shape so the `web_search` tool and the rest of the system never see
provider details.

- [ExAthena.Sessions.SchemaStore](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Sessions.SchemaStore.md): Behaviour for row-shaped session storage (sessions / messages / snapshots).
- [ExAthena.Sessions.Stores.ETS](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Sessions.Stores.ETS.md): ETS-backed store implementing both `ExAthena.Sessions.Store` (event-log)
and `ExAthena.Sessions.SchemaStore` (row-shaped sessions / messages /
snapshots).
- [ExAthena.StructuredOutput](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.StructuredOutput.md): Strict structured-output helper. Requires provider `:structured_output` capability.
- [ExAthena.Terminal.Server](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Terminal.Server.md): One GenServer per embedded web terminal.
- [ExAthena.Tool.Spec](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tool.Spec.md): Canonical, unified representation of a tool — whether backed by a
behaviour-implementing module or a dynamically-discovered MCP tool.
- [ExAthena.ToolCalls.RawJson](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ToolCalls.RawJson.md): Best-effort parser for bare JSON tool calls embedded in assistant text.
- [ExAthena.Tools.ApplyPatch](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.ApplyPatch.md): Apply a unified diff patch across one or more files atomically.
- [ExAthena.Tools.AskUser](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.AskUser.md): Ask the human a clarifying question mid-run and block until they answer.
- [ExAthena.Tools.Lsp](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Lsp.md): Built-in tool that exposes Language Server Protocol queries to the model.
- [ExAthena.Tools.UsageRules](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.UsageRules.md): Read dependency **usage rules** — the LLM-oriented `usage-rules.md` docs that
Elixir libraries ship in their Hex package (the `usage_rules` convention).
- [ExAthena.Tools.WebSearch](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.WebSearch.md): Search the web and return ranked results (title, url, snippet).
- [ExAthena.Web.Endpoint](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Web.Endpoint.md)
- [ExAthena.Web.ErrorHTML](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Web.ErrorHTML.md)
- [ExAthena.Web.Layouts](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Web.Layouts.md)
- [ExAthena.Web.Live.ChatLive](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Web.Live.ChatLive.md)
- [ExAthena.Web.Router](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Web.Router.md)
- [ExAthena.Web.RunServer](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Web.RunServer.md): Per-session owner of one in-flight agent run, decoupled from the LiveView.
- [ExAthena.Web.Sessions](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Web.Sessions.md): File-based session persistence for the web UI.

- Core API
  - [ExAthena](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.md): Provider-agnostic agent loop for Elixir.
  - [ExAthena.Config](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Config.md): Resolves the provider and per-call options for an ExAthena request.
  - [ExAthena.Request](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Request.md): A normalised inference request.
  - [ExAthena.Response](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Response.md): A normalised inference response.
  - [ExAthena.Result](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Result.md): Canonical run outcome returned by `ExAthena.run/2` and
`ExAthena.Loop.run/2`.

- Agent loop
  - [ExAthena.Budget](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Budget.md): Usage + cost accounting and budget checks for agent runs.
  - [ExAthena.Loop](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Loop.md): Agent-loop kernel. Dispatches to a `ExAthena.Loop.Mode` implementation
and handles everything around it: caps, budget, hooks, counters, events,
and termination accounting.
  - [ExAthena.Loop.Events](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Loop.Events.md): Flat, pattern-matchable event tuples the loop emits to `:on_event`.
  - [ExAthena.Loop.Mode](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Loop.Mode.md): Pluggable control-flow strategy for the agent loop.
  - [ExAthena.Loop.Parallel](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Loop.Parallel.md): Parallel tool-call dispatcher.
  - [ExAthena.Loop.State](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Loop.State.md): Internal state of a running agent loop.
  - [ExAthena.Loop.Terminations](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Loop.Terminations.md): Typed termination subtypes for agent-loop runs.
  - [ExAthena.Session](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Session.md): GenServer that owns a multi-turn conversation.
  - [ExAthena.Structured](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Structured.md): One-shot structured extraction backed by a JSON schema.

- Modes
  - [ExAthena.Modes.PlanAndSolve](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Modes.PlanAndSolve.md): Plan-and-Solve mode.
  - [ExAthena.Modes.ReAct](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Modes.ReAct.md): Default mode: Reason-Act cycle.
  - [ExAthena.Modes.Reflexion](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Modes.Reflexion.md): Reflexion mode: after each ReAct iteration, insert a short self-critique
pass before the next turn.

- Messages
  - [ExAthena.Messages](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Messages.md): Canonical in-memory representation of a conversation.
  - [ExAthena.Messages.Message](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Messages.Message.md): A single turn in the conversation.
  - [ExAthena.Messages.ToolCall](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Messages.ToolCall.md): A tool call the model wants the runtime to execute.
  - [ExAthena.Messages.ToolResult](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Messages.ToolResult.md): The outcome of a tool execution, replayed back to the model.

- Provider contract
  - [ExAthena.Capabilities](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Capabilities.md): Provider-capability map shape.
  - [ExAthena.Provider](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Provider.md): Behaviour every provider must implement.

- Providers
  - [ExAthena.Providers.Mock](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Providers.Mock.md): In-memory provider for tests.
  - [ExAthena.Providers.ReqLLM](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Providers.ReqLLM.md): Delegating provider that runs requests through the `req_llm` library.

- Provider configuration
  - [ExAthena.ModelDiscovery](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ModelDiscovery.md): Generic HTTP-based model listing backed by an ETS TTL cache.
  - [ExAthena.ProviderRegistry](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ProviderRegistry.md): GenServer that loads provider specs from `~/.config/ex_athena/providers/` at
startup and makes them available for lookup.
  - [ExAthena.ProviderSpec](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ProviderSpec.md): Represents a provider loaded from a JSON file in the providers config directory.

- Request queue
  - [ExAthena.RequestQueue](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.RequestQueue.md): ETS-backed GenServer semaphore that limits concurrent in-flight requests per provider.
  - [ExAthena.RequestQueue.Supervisor](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.RequestQueue.Supervisor.md): Supervisor for the `ExAthena.RequestQueue` GenServer.

- Tool calls
  - [ExAthena.ToolCalls](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ToolCalls.md): Extracts tool calls from a provider response.
  - [ExAthena.ToolCalls.Native](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ToolCalls.Native.md): Parses native tool-call structures from provider responses.
  - [ExAthena.ToolCalls.TextTagged](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ToolCalls.TextTagged.md): Parses `~~~tool_call` fenced blocks out of assistant text.

- Tool contract
  - [ExAthena.Tool](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tool.md): Behaviour every tool must implement.
  - [ExAthena.ToolContext](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.ToolContext.md): Context handed to every tool execution.
  - [ExAthena.Tools](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.md): Resolves tools into `ExAthena.Tool.Spec` structs for the provider and loop.

- Builtin tools
  - [ExAthena.Tools.Bash](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Bash.md): Executes a shell command via `/bin/sh -c` with a configurable timeout.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.Edit](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Edit.md): Exact-string replacement in a file.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.Finish](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Finish.md): Built-in completion signal tool.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.Glob](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Glob.md): Finds files matching a glob pattern, relative to `ctx.cwd`.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.Grep](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Grep.md): Search file contents with a regex under `ctx.cwd`.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.PlanMode](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.PlanMode.md): Toggle the loop's permission phase.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.Read](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Read.md): Reads a file from the filesystem.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.SpawnAgent](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.SpawnAgent.md): Synchronously run a sub-agent-loop with its own prompt, tools, and budget.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.TodoWrite](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.TodoWrite.md): Writes the agent's todo list.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.WebFetch](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.WebFetch.md): HTTP GET via `Req`, returning the body as text.
  - [ExAthena.Tools.Write](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Tools.Write.md): Creates or overwrites a file with the given content.

- Memory + Skills
  - [ExAthena.Memory](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Memory.md): File-based project memory.
  - [ExAthena.Skills](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Skills.md): Claude Code-style skills with progressive disclosure.
  - [ExAthena.Skills.Skill](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Skills.Skill.md): A discovered skill. `body` is the markdown after the frontmatter,
loaded only when needed; the catalog only ever uses `name` and
`description`.

- Compaction pipeline
  - [ExAthena.Compactor](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactor.md): Behaviour for context-window compaction.
  - [ExAthena.Compactor.Pipeline](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactor.Pipeline.md): Multi-stage context-compaction runner.
  - [ExAthena.Compactor.Stage](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactor.Stage.md): Behaviour for a single compaction stage.
  - [ExAthena.Compactors.BudgetReduction](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactors.BudgetReduction.md): First stage of the compaction pipeline. Replaces oversized tool-result
contents with a short reference pointer.
  - [ExAthena.Compactors.ContextCollapse](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactors.ContextCollapse.md): Fourth pipeline stage — non-destructive view-time projection.
  - [ExAthena.Compactors.Microcompact](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactors.Microcompact.md): Third pipeline stage — collapses runs of repetitive tool calls.
  - [ExAthena.Compactors.Snip](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactors.Snip.md): Second pipeline stage — drops *old* tool-result messages whose paired
assistant turn already happened.
  - [ExAthena.Compactors.Summary](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Compactors.Summary.md): Default `ExAthena.Compactor` — replaces the middle of message history
with a short LLM-generated summary.

- Permissions + hooks
  - [ExAthena.Hooks](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Hooks.md): Lifecycle hooks the loop fires at key transitions.
  - [ExAthena.Permissions](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Permissions.md): Decides whether a tool call is allowed.
  - [ExAthena.Permissions.Denial](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Permissions.Denial.md): Structured permission-denial returned by `ExAthena.Permissions.check/3`.

- Confinement
  - [ExAthena.Net](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Net.md): Network address classification for the web tools' SSRF guard.
  - [ExAthena.Sandbox](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Sandbox.md): OS-level command confinement for the Bash tool.

- Agents
  - [ExAthena.Agents](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Agents.md): Custom agent definitions loaded from YAML/markdown files.
  - [ExAthena.Agents.Definition](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Agents.Definition.md): A single named agent loaded from a markdown+frontmatter file.
  - [ExAthena.Agents.Sidechain](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Agents.Sidechain.md): Writes a subagent's transcript to disk so it doesn't bloat the
parent's context.
  - [ExAthena.Agents.Worktree](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Agents.Worktree.md): Git-worktree isolation for subagents.
  - [ExAthena.Agents.WorktreeSweeper](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Agents.WorktreeSweeper.md): One-shot startup task that GCs orphaned ex_athena git worktrees.

- Sessions
  - [ExAthena.Sessions.Store](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Sessions.Store.md): Behaviour for append-only session event storage.
  - [ExAthena.Sessions.Stores.InMemory](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Sessions.Stores.InMemory.md): ETS-backed in-memory session store. Default; ephemeral.
  - [ExAthena.Sessions.Stores.Jsonl](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Sessions.Stores.Jsonl.md): ETS-buffered JSONL session store.

- Checkpointing
  - [ExAthena.Checkpoint](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Checkpoint.md): File-history checkpointing + rewind.
  - [ExAthena.Checkpoint.Sweeper](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Checkpoint.Sweeper.md): One-shot startup task that GCs file-history directories older than
30 days. Runs alongside the `Agents.WorktreeSweeper`.

- Streaming
  - [ExAthena.Streaming](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Streaming.md): Canonical streaming event types and the broadcaster helper.
  - [ExAthena.Streaming.Event](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Streaming.Event.md): A single streaming event.

- Telemetry
  - [ExAthena.Telemetry](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Telemetry.md): Telemetry emission for ExAthena, shaped to the OpenTelemetry GenAI
semantic conventions so consumers can plug directly into OTel without
a translation layer.

- Errors
  - [ExAthena.Error](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Error.md): Canonical error surface across providers.

- MCP
  - [ExAthena.Mcp](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Mcp.md): Facade for MCP (Model Context Protocol) server management.
  - [ExAthena.Mcp.Client](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/ExAthena.Mcp.Client.md): JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP client GenServer.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix athena.chat](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Athena.Chat.md): Drops you into an interactive chat session against the ExAthena agent loop.
- [mix athena.web](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Athena.Web.md): Starts the ExAthena web chat UI on localhost.
- [mix ex_athena.install](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExAthena.Install.md): Installs ExAthena into your project.
- [mix ex_athena.upgrade](https://ex-athena.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExAthena.Upgrade.md): Igniter upgrader task. Invoked automatically by
`mix igniter.upgrade ex_athena` after the dependency is bumped;
can also be invoked directly via `mix ex_athena.upgrade <from> <to>`.
